requirements_summary: Workload: real-time product search + nightly batch embeddings ingestion (~100k rows/day)
Targets: 150-250 qps at 95th latency < 300ms end-to-end for search flow; batch embed throughput to finish nightly jobs within 3 hours.
Model preferences: 1536-d embeddings initially (open models acceptable), plan to test larger models for quality vs cost tradeoffs.
Routing/fallback: want auto-fallback to smaller embedding models during spikes; prefer model pinning for canary rollouts.
Vector DB integration: must support Pinecone OR Milvus; standard connector expected, kludge-free SDK in Python.
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, and error traces required for SLOs.
Security: SSO/SAML, customer-managed keys (KMS), audit logs, EU data residency for a subset of merchant data.
Operational: dedicated pool sizing, burst capacity, and predictable monthly cost for budgeting.
